benchmarkGates: source-specific adapters for observations, forecasts and labels
temporal train/validation/test split with no future leakage
published confusion matrix, calibration and false-negative rates
independent rerun on a fresh release before any 99% claim
caveats: Current release is contextual intelligence and benchmark design, not an operational warning system.
The 99% target is intentionally represented as a required gate; no capability claims it without validated holdout metrics.
